title: Your Tattoo is INSIDE Your Immune System. Literally
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】你的刺青就在你的免疫系統內。字面上地（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Your tattoos are inside your immune system, literally. With each very tasteful piece of art,
cues.en: Your tattoos are inside your immune system, literally. With each very tasteful piece of art,
cues.zh: 從字面上看，你的刺青位於你的免疫系統內。每一件都極具品味的藝術品，

cues.text: you kick start a drama with millions of deaths, grand sacrifices and your immune system stepping in to protect you from yourself.
cues.en: you kick start a drama with millions of deaths, grand sacrifices and your immune system stepping in to protect you from yourself.
cues.zh: 你開始了一場戲劇，數百萬人死亡，巨大的犧牲和你的免疫系統介入以保護你免受自己的侵害。

cues.text: Let's give you a tattoo and zoom in to see what happens inside your skin.
cues.en: Let's give you a tattoo and zoom in to see what happens inside your skin.
cues.zh: 讓我們給你紋身並放大看看你的皮膚內部發生了什麼。

cues.text: The Conveyor Belt of Death Your skin has to solve a huge problem – it's your largest organ and has the most direct contact with
cues.en: The Conveyor Belt of Death Your skin has to solve a huge problem – it's your largest organ and has the most direct contact with
cues.zh: 死亡傳送帶 您的皮膚必須解決一個巨大的問題—它是您最大的器官，並且與身體接觸最直接。

cues.text: the world around you. Trillions of microbes, dirt, insects and vermin can’t be allowed to get inside you
cues.en: the world around you. Trillions of microbes, dirt, insects and vermin can’t be allowed to get inside you
cues.zh: 你周圍的世界。數以兆計的微生物、汙垢、昆蟲和害蟲不能進入您的體內

cues.text: but your skin is also constantly damaged by you moving through the world.
cues.en: but your skin is also constantly damaged by you moving through the world.
cues.zh: 但您的皮膚也會因您在世界各地的活動而不斷受損。

cues.text: Your body solved this by making your skin a conveyor belt of death. All the skin you see
cues.en: Your body solved this by making your skin a conveyor belt of death. All the skin you see
cues.zh: 你的身體透過讓你的皮膚成為死亡傳送帶來解決這個問題。你看到的所有皮膚

cues.text: is actually dead stuff. The alive part of your skin cells begins around one millimeter deep,
cues.en: is actually dead stuff. The alive part of your skin cells begins around one millimeter deep,
cues.zh: 實際上是死東西。皮膚細胞的活性部分從一毫米深開始，

cues.text: in the skin industrial complex. Stem cells constantly clone themselves producing new
cues.en: in the skin industrial complex. Stem cells constantly clone themselves producing new
cues.zh: 在皮膚工業區。幹細胞不斷複製自身，產生新的

cues.text: skin cells that begin a journey from the inside to the outside.
cues.en: skin cells that begin a journey from the inside to the outside.
cues.zh: 皮膚細胞開始從內到外的旅程。

cues.text: Each new generation pushes the older ones further up. As your skin cells mature,
cues.en: Each new generation pushes the older ones further up. As your skin cells mature,
cues.zh: 每一代新人都會把老一輩推得更遠。當你的皮膚細胞成熟時，

cues.text: they interlock with each other and produce Lamellar bodies, tiny bags that squirt out
cues.en: they interlock with each other and produce Lamellar bodies, tiny bags that squirt out
cues.zh: 它們彼此連鎖並產生層狀體，即噴射出來的小袋

cues.text: fat to create a waterproof coat that closes any gaps between them.
cues.en: fat to create a waterproof coat that closes any gaps between them.
cues.zh: 脂肪形成防水層，封閉它們之間的間隙。

cues.text: And then, they dry out and kill themselves, merging together into inseparable lumps.
cues.en: And then, they dry out and kill themselves, merging together into inseparable lumps.
cues.zh: 然後，它們變乾並自殺，融合成不可分離的團塊。

cues.text: This wall of dead corpses is consistently pushed upwards. Up to 50 layers of dead
cues.en: This wall of dead corpses is consistently pushed upwards. Up to 50 layers of dead
cues.zh: 這堵死屍牆不斷向上推。最多 50 層死亡

cues.text: cells cover your whole body and are constantly replaced by new cells moving up. Every hour,
cues.en: cells cover your whole body and are constantly replaced by new cells moving up. Every hour,
cues.zh: 細胞覆蓋你的整個身體，並且不斷地被向上移動的新細胞所取代。每個小時，

cues.text: you shed around 200,000,000 dead skin cells and all the dirt or bacteria that are stuck to them.
cues.en: you shed around 200,000,000 dead skin cells and all the dirt or bacteria that are stuck to them.
cues.zh: 您將脫落大約 2 億個死皮細胞以及粘在其上的所有汙垢或細菌。

cues.text: Tattooing this part of your skin would be useless as nothing would stick around. We need to go deeper.
cues.en: Tattooing this part of your skin would be useless as nothing would stick around. We need to go deeper.
cues.zh: 在這部分皮膚上紋身是沒有用的，因為不會留下任何東西。我們需要更深入。

cues.text: When the Fleshy World Explodes Below the conveyor belt of death lies the dermis. It's full of structural tissue and cells,
cues.en: When the Fleshy World Explodes Below the conveyor belt of death lies the dermis. It's full of structural tissue and cells,
cues.zh: 當肉體世界爆炸時 死亡傳送帶下方是真皮。它充滿了結構組織和細胞，

cues.text: tiny blood vessels, sensory cells that report to nerve endings, the roots of your hairs,
cues.en: tiny blood vessels, sensory cells that report to nerve endings, the roots of your hairs,
cues.zh: 微小的血管、向神經末梢報告的感覺細胞、頭髮的根部，

cues.text: sweat glands regulating your temperature. And of course loads of immune cells,
cues.en: sweat glands regulating your temperature. And of course loads of immune cells,
cues.zh: 汗腺調節你的體溫。當然還有大量的免疫細胞，

cues.text: guarding your flesh right below the moving border wall.
cues.en: guarding your flesh right below the moving border wall.
cues.zh: 在移動的邊界牆下方保護你的肉體。

cues.text: This region and below is where your new tattoo will go. Ok! Ready?
cues.en: This region and below is where your new tattoo will go. Ok! Ready?
cues.zh: 該區域及其下方是您的新紋身所在的位置。好的！準備好？

cues.text: The world explodes. Half a dozen monoliths the size of skyscrapers slam through the fifty
cues.en: The world explodes. Half a dozen monoliths the size of skyscrapers slam through the fifty
cues.zh: 世界爆炸了。六座摩天大樓大小的巨石猛烈地衝過五十個街區

cues.text: layers of dead cells, deep into the dermis, ripping huge holes into the skin – only to
cues.en: layers of dead cells, deep into the dermis, ripping huge holes into the skin – only to
cues.zh: 層層死亡細胞深入真皮，在皮膚上撕開巨大的洞——只是為了

cues.text: retreat and smash through the tissue again about twice a second. Tens of thousands
cues.en: retreat and smash through the tissue again about twice a second. Tens of thousands
cues.zh: 每秒兩次撤回並再次粉碎組織。數萬

cues.text: of cells are violently killed right away, ripped into pieces or damaged beyond repair.
cues.en: of cells are violently killed right away, ripped into pieces or damaged beyond repair.
cues.zh: 細胞立即被猛烈殺死，撕成碎片或損壞至無法修復。

cues.text: Luckily, you did your research and chose a responsible tattoo artist who properly
cues.en: Luckily, you did your research and chose a responsible tattoo artist who properly
cues.zh: 幸運的是，您做了研究並選擇了一位負責任的紋身藝術家，他正確地

cues.text: disinfected their tools and your skin. But you only ever get 99.9% of all bacteria,
cues.en: disinfected their tools and your skin. But you only ever get 99.9% of all bacteria,
cues.zh: 對他們的工具和你的皮膚進行消毒。但你只能感染 99.9% 的細菌，

cues.text: and some of the survivors made it into your flesh.
cues.en: and some of the survivors made it into your flesh.
cues.zh: 一些倖存者進入了你的肉體。

cues.text: To put it mildly, your immune system is not amused at all! All the death and destruction
cues.en: To put it mildly, your immune system is not amused at all! All the death and destruction
cues.zh: 說得客氣一點，你的免疫系統一點也不高興！所有的死亡與毀滅

cues.text: wakes up hundreds of thousands of Macrophages in your dermis, that rush into the open wounds to
cues.en: wakes up hundreds of thousands of Macrophages in your dermis, that rush into the open wounds to
cues.zh: 喚醒真皮層中數十萬個巨噬細胞，它們衝入開放性傷口，

cues.text: defend you. Immediately they start killing bacteria, release chemicals that call for
cues.en: defend you. Immediately they start killing bacteria, release chemicals that call for
cues.zh: 保衛你。它們立即開始殺死細菌，釋放所需的化學物質

cues.text: reinforcements and order your blood vessels to open up and make your dermis swell up with fluid.
cues.en: reinforcements and order your blood vessels to open up and make your dermis swell up with fluid.
cues.zh: 強化並命令您的血管開啟並使您的真皮因液體而腫脹。

cues.text: But worse than the hundreds of wounds and a few invaders is the tidal wave
cues.en: But worse than the hundreds of wounds and a few invaders is the tidal wave
cues.zh: 但比數百處傷口和少數入侵者更糟糕的是海嘯

cues.text: of chemicals that floods your tissue. Tattoo ink can be made from hundreds of substances,
cues.en: of chemicals that floods your tissue. Tattoo ink can be made from hundreds of substances,
cues.zh: 充滿您組織的化學物質。紋身墨水可以由數百種物質製成，

cues.text: some may even be toxic or carcinogenic. Most are from heavy metals like lead,
cues.en: some may even be toxic or carcinogenic. Most are from heavy metals like lead,
cues.zh: 有些甚至可能有毒或致癌。大部分來自鉛等重金屬，

cues.text: nickel or chromium dissolved in distilled water.
cues.en: nickel or chromium dissolved in distilled water.
cues.zh: 鎳或鉻溶解在蒸餾水中。

cues.text: The battlefield is now a wild mix of dead cell parts, a few panicked bacteria,
cues.en: The battlefield is now a wild mix of dead cell parts, a few panicked bacteria,
cues.zh: 戰場現在是死亡細胞部分、一些驚慌失措的細菌的瘋狂混合體，

cues.text: blood and bodily fluids, platelet cells trying to close wounds,
cues.en: blood and bodily fluids, platelet cells trying to close wounds,
cues.zh: 血液和體液，試圖閉合傷口的血小板細胞，

cues.text: more and more fresh immune cells and the flood of tattoo ink.
cues.en: more and more fresh immune cells and the flood of tattoo ink.
cues.zh: 越來越多的新鮮免疫細胞和大量的紋身墨水。

cues.text: On the scale of your cells, clumps of ink particles are huge – if you were
cues.en: On the scale of your cells, clumps of ink particles are huge – if you were
cues.zh: 在你的細胞規模上，墨水顆粒團塊是巨大的——如果你是的話

cues.text: the size of a cell, they’d range from big dogs to small office buildings.
cues.en: the size of a cell, they’d range from big dogs to small office buildings.
cues.zh: 它們的大小如牢房大小，範圍從大型犬到小型辦公大樓。

cues.text: Your immune system has one main job: Identify what is not you and smash it until it's dead.
cues.en: Your immune system has one main job: Identify what is not you and smash it until it's dead.
cues.zh: 你的免疫系統有一項主要工作：識別不屬於你的東西並將其粉碎直至死亡。

cues.text: The Macrophages are desperately trying to do that. Like tiny octopuses,
cues.en: The Macrophages are desperately trying to do that. Like tiny octopuses,
cues.zh: 巨噬細胞正拼命地嘗試做到這一點。就像小章魚一樣，

cues.text: they extend arm-like structures and begin pulling the ink particles inside. Usually,
cues.en: they extend arm-like structures and begin pulling the ink particles inside. Usually,
cues.zh: 它們延伸出類似手臂的結構，並開始將墨水顆粒拉入其中。通常，

cues.text: when a Macrophage has eaten an enemy, it showers it in acid to dissolve it. But this doesn’t work
cues.en: when a Macrophage has eaten an enemy, it showers it in acid to dissolve it. But this doesn’t work
cues.zh: 當巨噬細胞吃掉敵人時，它會用酸將其溶解。但這不起作用

cues.text: with the ink. They try and try but nothing works, the particles don't react in any way.
cues.en: with the ink. They try and try but nothing works, the particles don't react in any way.
cues.zh: 與墨水。他們嘗試了又嘗試，但沒有任何效果，粒子不會以任何方式反應。

cues.text: And this is just the particles small enough to be devoured.
cues.en: And this is just the particles small enough to be devoured.
cues.zh: 而這還只是小到可以被吞噬的顆粒。

cues.text: By now the larger chunks are surrounded by thousands of your structural skin cells
cues.en: By now the larger chunks are surrounded by thousands of your structural skin cells
cues.zh: 現在，較大的塊被數千個皮膚結構細胞包圍

cues.text: and macrophages that are nomming on them, bathing them in acid and attack chemicals
cues.en: and macrophages that are nomming on them, bathing them in acid and attack chemicals
cues.zh: 巨噬細胞對它們進行攻擊，將它們浸泡在酸中並攻擊化學物質

cues.text: trying to destroy and kill them. But they are not moving even a tiny bit.
cues.en: trying to destroy and kill them. But they are not moving even a tiny bit.
cues.zh: 試圖摧毀並殺死他們。但他們卻一動也不動。

cues.text: Nothing works!
cues.en: Nothing works!
cues.zh: 什麼都不起作用！

cues.text: Finally your immune system has to concede. It will not win this fight – so it does the next
cues.en: Finally your immune system has to concede. It will not win this fight – so it does the next
cues.zh: 最後你的免疫系統不得不讓步。它不會贏得這場戰鬥——所以它會贏得下一場戰鬥

cues.text: best thing: Not lose. Your cells don’t know how dangerous these metals and chemicals are,
cues.en: best thing: Not lose. Your cells don’t know how dangerous these metals and chemicals are,
cues.zh: 最好的事：不輸。你的細胞不知道這些金屬和化學物質有多危險，

cues.text: but they can at least not let them spread around. So they just stay in place. They
cues.en: but they can at least not let them spread around. So they just stay in place. They
cues.zh: 但至少可以不讓它們四處蔓延。所以他們只是待在原地。他們

cues.text: vacuum up all the particles they can fit into their bodies and surround the larger
cues.en: vacuum up all the particles they can fit into their bodies and surround the larger
cues.zh: 真空吸走所有可以放入其體內的顆粒並包圍較大的顆粒

cues.text: ones trapping them in the only prison they can build: themselves. Bit by bit, the ink inside
cues.en: ones trapping them in the only prison they can build: themselves. Bit by bit, the ink inside
cues.zh: 那些將他們困在他們唯一能建造的監獄裡的人：他們自己。一點一點，裡面的墨水

cues.text: thousands of tiny wounds moves inside millions of immune cells that freeze in place forever.
cues.en: thousands of tiny wounds moves inside millions of immune cells that freeze in place forever.
cues.zh: 數以千計的微小傷口在數百萬個永遠凍結的免疫細胞內移動。

cues.text: On the outside you don’t notice any of this. Your new tattoo is fresh and the
cues.en: On the outside you don’t notice any of this. Your new tattoo is fresh and the
cues.zh: 從外面看，你不會注意到這些。你的新刺青很新鮮

cues.text: colours vibrant. Your skin hurts and is irritated and swollen. But wounds heal,
cues.en: colours vibrant. Your skin hurts and is irritated and swollen. But wounds heal,
cues.zh: 色彩鮮豔。您的皮膚感到疼痛、發炎和腫脹。但傷口癒合了，

cues.text: tiny holes close, dead cells are replaced. Bit by bit, the conveyor belt of death does its job,
cues.en: tiny holes close, dead cells are replaced. Bit by bit, the conveyor belt of death does its job,
cues.zh: 小孔關閉，死亡細胞被替換。死亡傳送帶一點一點地完成它的工作，

cues.text: shedding dead cells ripe in colour, replacing them with fresh and clean ones. Your tattoo
cues.en: shedding dead cells ripe in colour, replacing them with fresh and clean ones. Your tattoo
cues.zh: 脫落顏色成熟的死亡細胞，代之以新鮮乾淨的細胞。你的紋身

cues.text: becomes a little less vibrant, now the ink is no longer on your skin but inside it.
cues.en: becomes a little less vibrant, now the ink is no longer on your skin but inside it.
cues.zh: 變得不那麼充滿活力，現在墨水不再在您的皮膚上，而是在皮膚內部。

cues.text: But what you are really seeing is millions of your Macrophages, sitting in your dermis, patiently holding the ink in place, protecting your body
cues.en: But what you are really seeing is millions of your Macrophages, sitting in your dermis, patiently holding the ink in place, protecting your body
cues.zh: 但你真正看到的是數以百萬計的巨噬細胞，它們坐在你的真皮中，耐心地將墨水固定在適當的位置，保護你的身體

cues.text: from poison. Your immune system is why your tattoo is forever.
cues.en: from poison. Your immune system is why your tattoo is forever.
cues.zh: 來自毒。你的免疫系統是你刺青永恆的原因。

cues.text: Actually Nothing is Forever Over time your Macrophages get old and die and new ones come in to gobble up the ink
cues.en: Actually Nothing is Forever Over time your Macrophages get old and die and new ones come in to gobble up the ink
cues.zh: 事實上，沒有什麼是永遠的，隨著時間的推移，你的巨噬細胞會變老並死亡，新的巨噬細胞會進來吞噬墨水

cues.text: and keep it in place. But sometimes a tiny bit of ink escapes. Most of it
cues.en: and keep it in place. But sometimes a tiny bit of ink escapes. Most of it
cues.zh: 並將其保持在適當的位置。但有時會有一點墨水逸出。大部分都是

cues.text: is recaptured and locked in place, but not always the exact same place.
cues.en: is recaptured and locked in place, but not always the exact same place.
cues.zh: 被重新捕獲並鎖定在適當的位置，但並不總是完全相同的位置。

cues.text: You notice that as your tattoo fades out a bit and turns less sharp and crisp at its edges.
cues.en: You notice that as your tattoo fades out a bit and turns less sharp and crisp at its edges.
cues.zh: 您會注意到，您的紋身會逐漸淡化，邊緣變得不那麼銳利和清晰。

cues.text: Some of the ink escapes the tattoo entirely. It rides fluids flowing from your tissue
cues.en: Some of the ink escapes the tattoo entirely. It rides fluids flowing from your tissue
cues.zh: 一些墨水完全從紋身中消失。它隨著從組織中流出的液體流動

cues.text: and spreads around your body, another reason why tattoo ink should ideally not be poison.
cues.en: and spreads around your body, another reason why tattoo ink should ideally not be poison.
cues.zh: 並擴散到您的身體各處，這是紋身墨水理想情況下不應有毒的另一個原因。

cues.text: Your immune system also kind of doesn’t want you to remove tattoos – to do that usually the
cues.en: Your immune system also kind of doesn’t want you to remove tattoos – to do that usually the
cues.zh: 你的免疫系統也不希望你去除刺青——這樣做通常是

cues.text: ink is shot at with lasers, which heats up the particles until they break into smaller chunks,
cues.en: ink is shot at with lasers, which heats up the particles until they break into smaller chunks,
cues.zh: 用雷射照射墨水，加熱顆粒直到它們分解成更小的塊，

cues.text: cooking your brave Macrophages in the process. With every round of lasering,
cues.en: cooking your brave Macrophages in the process. With every round of lasering,
cues.zh: 過程中烹調你勇敢的巨噬細胞。每一輪雷射照射，

cues.text: more of your tattoo is broken down and carried away by fluids. But also every time
cues.en: more of your tattoo is broken down and carried away by fluids. But also every time
cues.zh: 更多的紋身會被液體分解和帶走。但也每一次

cues.text: new Macrophages rush into the tattoo to lock the ink in place. So like uhm,
cues.en: new Macrophages rush into the tattoo to lock the ink in place. So like uhm,
cues.zh: 新的巨噬細胞衝進紋身，將墨水鎖定到位。所以就像嗯，

cues.text: maybe think about it carefully before you get the name of your new bae tattooed, but you do you.
cues.en: maybe think about it carefully before you get the name of your new bae tattooed, but you do you.
cues.zh: 也許在你給你的新寶貝紋上名字之前要仔細考慮一下，但你確實這麼做了。

cues.text: But if you got one, you can directly see your immune system protecting you. This
cues.en: But if you got one, you can directly see your immune system protecting you. This
cues.zh: 但如果你有一個，你可以直接看到你的免疫系統在保護你。這個

cues.text: is how much your body loves you, which is kind of sweet. And while tattoos are
cues.en: is how much your body loves you, which is kind of sweet. And while tattoos are
cues.zh: 是你的身體有多愛你，這是一種甜蜜。雖然刺青是

cues.text: probably not that big of a deal for your body if applied correctly: you now know
cues.en: probably not that big of a deal for your body if applied correctly: you now know
cues.zh: 如果應用得當，對您的身體可能沒什麼大不了的：您現在知道了

cues.text: about the struggle going on inside your skin and the sacrifice of your Macrophage buddies,
cues.en: about the struggle going on inside your skin and the sacrifice of your Macrophage buddies,
cues.zh: 關於你皮膚內部發生的鬥爭和你的巨噬細胞夥伴的犧牲，

cues.text: only for you to have that art forever.
cues.en: only for you to have that art forever.
